enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to left side. Stretch legs. Move arm under pillow. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning hygiene routine: washing face, brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Pick up toothbrush and apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap and light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, and bread. Close refrigerator. Take out plate and pan from cupboard. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan and cook. Toast bread. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table and eat breakfast. Clear dishes. Turn off stove.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt, pants, and socks. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt and button. Put on pants and zip. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Look in mirror and adjust collar. Pick up bag and check phone. Exit bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop and wait. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone and read messages. Put phone away. Stand up and pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to workplace and enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Clock in. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check schedule. Review patient charts. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Take vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart and lungs. Administer medication. Update records. Use computer. Consult with colleagues. Attend meeting. Eat lunch. Wash hands. Continue patient rounds. Clock out.
Walk to bus stop and wait. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone and read messages. Put phone away. Stand up and pull cord. Exit bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash and chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Cook meat and stir. Add vegetables and season. Turn off stove. Serve onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner and drink water. Clear table and rinse dishes. Load dishwasher and turn off light. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time: watching TV, using computer, relaxing
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on light. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV and change channels. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Type and browse internet. Watch video. Put down computer. Stand up and walk to kitchen. Get snack and return. Sit on couch and continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Turn off light. Exit living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene routine: showering, brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light and water heater. Undress. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body and apply soap. Scrub and rinse. Turn off shower. Step out and dry with towel. Pick up toothbrush and apply toothpaste. Brush teeth and rinse mouth. Put toothbrush down and hang towel. Turn off light and exit bathroom.
Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to other side. Stretch legs. Continue sleeping.
